findings.kind: dimension label does not match drawn length
findings.element: lower dimension chain, segment between left exterior wall and partition (WOHNEN width)
findings.explanation: The segment runs from x=121.89 pt to x=286.30 pt = 164.41 pt. At the printed scale 1:100 (1 pt = 35.278 mm) that is 5.800 m, not 5.86 m.

findings.kind: dimension label does not match drawn length
findings.element: lower dimension chain, segment between partition and right exterior wall (SCHLAFEN/BAD width)
findings.explanation: The segment runs from x=289.56 pt to x=388.35 pt = 98.79 pt = 3.485 m at 1:100. The label reads 4.00 m, 0.515 m more than drawn.

findings.kind: dimension chain does not sum to the overall dimension
findings.element: lower dimension chain (30 / 5.86 / 11.5 / 4.00 / 30) versus the 10.00 overall dimension above it
findings.explanation: 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, but the overall dimension says 10.00 m and the building is in fact drawn 283.46 pt = 10.000 m wide. Replacing 5.86 with 5.80 and 4.00 with 3.485 makes the chain close exactly at 10.00 m.
The room is drawn 164.41 x 181.42 pt = 5.800 x 6.400 m = 37.12 m2. The label says 31.2 m2, about 5.9 m2 (16%) too little.
The room is drawn 98.79 x 115.80 pt = 3.485 x 4.085 m = 14.24 m2. The label says 13.4 m2, about 0.84 m2 (6%) too little.
The room is drawn 98.79 x 62.36 pt = 3.485 x 2.200 m = 7.67 m2. The label says 6.9 m2, about 0.77 m2 (10%) too little.

summary: The two overall dimensions (10.00 and 7.00 m), the 30 cm wall dimensions, the 11.5 cm partition and the three door openings all check out against the vector geometry at the printed 1:100 scale, so the drawing itself is internally consistent. The annotation layer is not: two segments of the lower dimension chain are mislabelled (5.86 instead of 5.80, 4.00 instead of 3.485), which makes the chain add up to 10.575 m against a 10.00 m overall, and all three room areas are printed low (31.2 vs 37.12, 13.4 vs 14.24, 6.9 vs 7.67 m2). Separately, worth confirming before issue: BAD has no door to WOHNEN and is reachable only through SCHLAFEN.
